# Mosaic Hostel Varanasi

> Premium budget hostel near Assi Ghat in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India. Established November 2025. Dorm beds and private rooms. Welcomes solo travellers, backpackers, groups and families seeking an authentic stay in one of the world's oldest cities.

## Location & Contact

- **Address:** B1/85C, Assi Ghat Road, Anandbagh, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh 221005, India
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +91-9125492225
- **Email:** mosaichostels@gmail.com
- **Website:** https://www.mosaichostels.com
- **Coordinates:** 25.28726, 83.00316 (about 100 m from Assi Ghat)

## Rooms

- **Dorms** (https://www.mosaichostels.com/dorms/): 10-bed mixed, 8-bed mixed, 6-bed mixed, 4-bed mixed, 6-bed female-only.
- **Private room** (https://www.mosaichostels.com/book-now): single and double occupancy, AC, ensuite bathroom.
- Check-in from 1:00 PM, check-out by 10:30 AM, 24-hour reception.

## Amenities

Free high-speed WiFi, air conditioning, hot-water showers, lockers, shared kitchen, rooftop space, 24-hour reception.

## Policies

Free cancellation up to 72 hours before check-in. Inside 72 hours the amount paid is not refunded. Pay in full, or a 50% deposit now with the balance due at check-in. Valid government photo ID required from every guest.
